gotcha #7 (tu93): env.reset() is NOT idempotent -- it leaves a parity-toggling hidden state (same path, 6 reset+replays -> levels [1,2,1,2,1,2]). A reuse-one-env replay/deepcopy search detects parity-CONTINGENT wins that fail the fresh-env reproduction gate (gate correctly rejects -- no false claim). Fix: OfflineSolver branch_mode='fresh_env' (a brand-new env per candidate eval) so each evaluation sees the same pristine parity-0 the gate uses. Detect by replaying ONE path on N fresh envs vs 1 env reset N times: if levels differ, reset is non-idempotent.

Some config/toggle games call next_level() in the same action that creates the winning arrangement, so the returned frame is already the next level and the pre-win grid is not externally observable. Ground the win predicate on execution state immediately before next_level, then count only the reproduce() level advance.

reusable_gotchas: Existing models/arc_verifier_r11l.json is a stale 4-feature checkpoint from the L1 first-contact path; _r11l intentionally sets featurize=None so the standing loop uses the hand verifier instead of loading the mismatched head.

recommended.win_condition: L1 click-to-template placement plus L2 handle-average placement: each non-dirwzt roefwu piece must collide with its flkdtg template; pieces with multiple roefwulewcui handles move to the average of handle centers.

recommended.action_model: ACTION6 click; data schema IS {x,y} and display->grid is 1:1 (camera.display_to_grid(30,13)==(30,13)). Clicks register (121/121 change the grid). Control is a PROGRAM/transform EDITOR, not direct steering: dispatch (tn36.py:2500) routes a click to a tool-palette (miytdaqzei, EMPTY at reset) else mvqheosngn(apply/2nd-object) else bzirenxmrg(the object); the object carries a move-program vkuvtkaerv=[3,0,3,0,0]; clicking it runs mmmdksslmq()->olrpupaury(). The exact EDIT->EXECUTE semantics that drive obj.y 13->33 are not yet cracked (directly invoking mmmdksslmq did NOT move the object; palette empty).
reusable_gotchas: CORRECTION (2026-06-17, deep RE): the prior 'ACTION6 schema is NOT {x,y} / KeyError x / explorer ERRORED' note is STALE/WRONG. {x,y} works; the KeyError only fires for data=None. rich_action_candidates emits {x,y} and graph_explore_solve_v2 runs CLEAN on tn36 (no error) — it just NO-ADVANCEs because the win needs the program-editor mechanic, not blind clicks.
tn36 is a multi-attribute alignment puzzle (move+scale+rotate+property to match a target), far harder than lp85's +1,+1 position-match — blind graph-explore can't drive 5 attributes onto a target.
recommended.solver: PROGRAM-EDITOR mechanic (FULLY RE'd 2026-06-17). The object runs an N-slot MOVE-PROGRAM (vkuvtkaerv); each slot holds a command code (tn36.py:2171 okllwtboml: 0=settle,1=left,2=right,3=down,33=up,5/6/7/16=rotate,8/9=scale+/-,14/15/63=property). Step CSPOIQWER=4. TOOL PALETTE = a 6-BIT code editor per slot: bit b's toggle-button is at (slot_x, slot_y_top + 3*b) for b=0..5 (values 1,2,4,8,16,32), so ANY code = sum of its set bits (down 3=bit0+bit1; up 33=bit0+bit5; scale+ 8=bit3; rotate+90 5=bit0+bit2). Slot positions ARE READABLE (controller.pfyayhyovw[i].{x,y}) and RE-LAY-OUT per level (L1: 5 slots; L2: 4 slots; different x/y) -> DISCOVER, don't hardcode. RUN by clicking the object sub-button sxhtkytekm (center, discovered). L1: program [3,3,3,3,3]=5 downs->y13->33. L2: [33,33,33,33]=4 ups->y24->8.
recommended.win_condition: MATCH a movable object to a target on FIVE attributes simultaneously: x, y, scale, rotation, and sjmtdfxdrc (a 5th property). Source: tn36.py:2153 vklyonlcrw = (obj.x==tgt.x and obj.y==tgt.y and obj.scale==tgt.scale and obj.rotation==tgt.rotation and obj.sjmtdfxdrc==tgt.sjmtdfxdrc). L1 at reset: obj=(x30,y13,s1,r0,sj11) tgt=(x30,y33,s1,r0,sj11) -> ONLY y is wrong (move down 20). Internal state is readable: env._game.fdksqlmpki.bzirenxmrg.{htntnzkbzu(obj),aqszntqeae(tgt)}.

Apply the offline-to-live value-head bridge fix by scoring only bounded decision points, caching repeated state scores, and reporting first-win or efficiency lift before any solve claim.
Reuse the productionized cheap value-routing substrate: v2+frame-delta features, bounded lazy value-head scoring, and frame-hash caching before reporting solve/first-win/action-efficiency lift.
Collect and relabel live-frontier off-path rows against reproduced action prefixes so DAgger-lite value heads train on the search distribution rather than winning-path states only.
Rank generated programmatic object experts by held-out transition trust, keep only replay-stable factors for product-model planning, and report overfit-prefix residuals before any solve claim.
Embed controllable action-effect deltas for intrinsic proposal novelty, reject cosmetic/raw-frame novelty when the controllability gate is active, and report transfer value before any solve claim.
Detect a level-up, clear stale level-local induction state, re-induce the next level predicate, and route the frontier with depth-primary goal bias.
Detect a level-up, request GOAL+DYNAMICS+plan candidates from an LLM proposer, rank them by trust energy, and fall back to DSL/verifier re-induction when live proposal is unavailable.
Re-derive replayable action coordinates from the current environment instead of trusting frozen live/offline pixel coordinates, then report drift recovery before any solve claim.
Rank compatible cached action/plan candidates by verifier score with stable tie-breaking and report ordering gain before any solve claim.
Rank executable world-model candidates by change-weighted held-out trust energy, reject identity/no-op degeneracy, and report value against the legacy binary exact-match gate before solve claims.

Rank action candidates with a leave-one-game cross-game memory of cached frame/action effects or the graduated live action-effect scorer, preserving original-order tie-breaking and reporting actions-to-first-levelup deltas before solve claims.

Reuse the .435 online-warm action-effect controller: combine leave-one-game PersistentAEM evidence with optional online-warm frame-change scores, keep the executable win-check outside ranking, and report first-win/efficiency transfer before any solve claim.

Rank generated frontier candidates by a depth-preserving convex blend of navigation energy and Exp4020 graded goal-satisfaction energy, then report solve/first-win/action-efficiency lift before any solve claim.

Reuse the .436 energy-fitness QD generator: keep naive candidates available, score generated candidates with oracle-distinct lower-is-better energy, preserve diverse behavior descriptors, and report coverage or first-win transfer before any solve claim.
A* frontier priority: standing path cost plus verifier/action-cost heuristic.
Build connected-component object slots, relational gap keypoints, and proposal-side coverage diagnostics before value ranking or frontier selection, without consulting the executable win-check.

recommended.action_model: ACTION6 click; data schema IS {x,y} and display->grid is 1:1 (camera.display_to_grid(30,13)==(30,13)). Clicks register (121/121 change the grid). Control is a PROGRAM/transform EDITOR, not direct steering: dispatch (tn36.py:2500) routes a click to a tool-palette (miytdaqzei, EMPTY at reset) else mvqheosngn(apply/2nd-object) else bzirenxmrg(the object); the object carries a move-program vkuvtkaerv=[3,0,3,0,0]; clicking it runs mmmdksslmq()->olrpupaury(). The exact EDIT->EXECUTE semantics that drive obj.y 13->33 are not yet cracked (directly invoking mmmdksslmq did NOT move the object; palette empty).
reusable_gotchas: CORRECTION (2026-06-17, deep RE): the prior 'ACTION6 schema is NOT {x,y} / KeyError x / explorer ERRORED' note is STALE/WRONG. {x,y} works; the KeyError only fires for data=None. rich_action_candidates emits {x,y} and graph_explore_solve_v2 runs CLEAN on tn36 (no error) — it just NO-ADVANCEs because the win needs the program-editor mechanic, not blind clicks.
tn36 is a multi-attribute alignment puzzle (move+scale+rotate+property to match a target), far harder than lp85's +1,+1 position-match — blind graph-explore can't drive 5 attributes onto a target.
recommended.solver: PROGRAM-EDITOR mechanic (FULLY RE'd 2026-06-17). The object runs an N-slot MOVE-PROGRAM (vkuvtkaerv); each slot holds a command code (tn36.py:2171 okllwtboml: 0=settle,1=left,2=right,3=down,33=up,5/6/7/16=rotate,8/9=scale+/-,14/15/63=property). Step CSPOIQWER=4. TOOL PALETTE = a 6-BIT code editor per slot: bit b's toggle-button is at (slot_x, slot_y_top + 3*b) for b=0..5 (values 1,2,4,8,16,32), so ANY code = sum of its set bits (down 3=bit0+bit1; up 33=bit0+bit5; scale+ 8=bit3; rotate+90 5=bit0+bit2). Slot positions ARE READABLE (controller.pfyayhyovw[i].{x,y}) and RE-LAY-OUT per level (L1: 5 slots; L2: 4 slots; different x/y) -> DISCOVER, don't hardcode. RUN by clicking the object sub-button sxhtkytekm (center, discovered). L1: program [3,3,3,3,3]=5 downs->y13->33. L2: [33,33,33,33]=4 ups->y24->8.
recommended.win_condition: MATCH a movable object to a target on FIVE attributes simultaneously: x, y, scale, rotation, and sjmtdfxdrc (a 5th property). Source: tn36.py:2153 vklyonlcrw = (obj.x==tgt.x and obj.y==tgt.y and obj.scale==tgt.scale and obj.rotation==tgt.rotation and obj.sjmtdfxdrc==tgt.sjmtdfxdrc). L1 at reset: obj=(x30,y13,s1,r0,sj11) tgt=(x30,y33,s1,r0,sj11) -> ONLY y is wrong (move down 20). Internal state is readable: env._game.fdksqlmpki.bzirenxmrg.{htntnzkbzu(obj),aqszntqeae(tgt)}.

selected_generic_operators.purpose: Execute the mechanic-class route by selecting the generated candidate for the routed toolkit approach, while falling back honestly when no routed candidate exists.
Apply the offline-to-live value-head bridge fix by scoring only bounded decision points, caching repeated state scores, and reporting first-win or efficiency lift before any solve claim.
Reuse the productionized cheap value-routing substrate: v2+frame-delta features, bounded lazy value-head scoring, and frame-hash caching before reporting solve/first-win/action-efficiency lift.
Collect and relabel live-frontier off-path rows against reproduced action prefixes so DAgger-lite value heads train on the search distribution rather than winning-path states only.
Rank generated programmatic object experts by held-out transition trust, keep only replay-stable factors for product-model planning, and report overfit-prefix residuals before any solve claim.
Embed controllable action-effect deltas for intrinsic proposal novelty, reject cosmetic/raw-frame novelty when the controllability gate is active, and report transfer value before any solve claim.
Detect a level-up, clear stale level-local induction state, re-induce the next level predicate, and route the frontier with depth-primary goal bias.
Detect a level-up, request GOAL+DYNAMICS+plan candidates from an LLM proposer, rank them by trust energy, and fall back to DSL/verifier re-induction when live proposal is unavailable.
Re-derive replayable action coordinates from the current environment instead of trusting frozen live/offline pixel coordinates, then report drift recovery before any solve claim.
Rank compatible cached action/plan candidates by verifier score with stable tie-breaking and report ordering gain before any solve claim.
Rank executable world-model candidates by change-weighted held-out trust energy, reject identity/no-op degeneracy, and report value against the legacy binary exact-match gate before solve claims.

Rank action candidates with a leave-one-game cross-game memory of cached frame/action effects or the graduated live action-effect scorer, preserving original-order tie-breaking and reporting actions-to-first-levelup deltas before solve claims.

Reuse the .435 online-warm action-effect controller: combine leave-one-game PersistentAEM evidence with optional online-warm frame-change scores, keep the executable win-check outside ranking, and report first-win/efficiency transfer before any solve claim.

Rank generated frontier candidates by a depth-preserving convex blend of navigation energy and Exp4020 graded goal-satisfaction energy, then report solve/first-win/action-efficiency lift before any solve claim.

Reuse the .436 energy-fitness QD generator: keep naive candidates available, score generated candidates with oracle-distinct lower-is-better energy, preserve diverse behavior descriptors, and report coverage or first-win transfer before any solve claim.
A* frontier priority: standing path cost plus verifier/action-cost heuristic.
Build connected-component object slots, relational gap keypoints, and proposal-side coverage diagnostics before value ranking or frontier selection, without consulting the executable win-check.
Connected-component object summary for routing, grounding, and active data.
